recoverPage.title: Recover your account
recoverPage.hint: Enter your organization and username. If an account matches, we'll send a password reset link to its registered email.
recoverPage.success: If that account exists, a recovery email has been sent.

orgsPage.title: Organizations
orgsPage.subtitle: Tenant organizations registered in Raum.
orgsPage.name: Name
orgsPage.currencyHint: What Kenoma invoices this org's subscription in.
orgsPage.productPricingCurrencyHint: What the org prices its own catalog in (Bime) - independent of billing currency, e.g. price in USD to match USD supply costs while being invoiced in ARS.
orgsPage.exportIntro: Queue an offboarding export of this organization's data. SQL is a restorable database dump; JSON/CSV are human-readable.
orgsPage.exportLayoutHint: Only applies to JSON/CSV — SQL always produces one restorable file per service.
orgsPage.exportActiveExists: An export is already in progress for this organization — showing its status.

exportsPage.title: Exports
exportsPage.subtitle: Tenant data export jobs queued across every organization.
exportsPage.noFilesRecorded: No files were recorded for this job - it likely completed before file tracking was added and can't be downloaded. Start a new export instead.

drBackupsPage.title: DR Backups
drBackupsPage.subtitle: Disaster-recovery backups captured across every organization and the platform's own instance. Grouped by organization and backup day - select the services you want to restore together.
drBackupsPage.restoreConfirm: Restore {{count}} selected backup(s) from {{target}}? This overwrites current data and cannot be undone.
drBackupsPage.restorePartialFailure: {{succeeded}} restored, {{failed}} failed. Check and retry the failed ones.

credentialsPage.title: Credentials
credentialsPage.subtitle: Register database credentials per organization and service.

onboardingPage.title: Onboarding
onboardingPage.subtitle: Bring a new organization online.
onboardingPage.hint: Creates the admin user in Vassago and seeds the initial Bime inventory preset for the given org.

usersPage.title: Users
usersPage.subtitle: Vassago accounts across your organization.
usersPage.changePasswordHint: Verifies your current password then sends a reset link to your registered email.
usersPage.publicKeyHint: The ES256 public key used to verify tokens issued by this Vassago instance.

bimeLocationsPage.title: Locations
bimeLocationsPage.subtitle: Warehouses, stores, and other stock locations.
bimeLocationsPage.name: Name

bimeMetadataPage.title: Metadata
bimeMetadataPage.subtitle: Product attribute definitions (like Color or Size) and their options.
bimeMetadataPage.name: Name
bimeMetadataPage.optionCodeHint: Short unique code used as a SKU fragment. Derived automatically from the value if left blank; required only if the value can't be turned into an ASCII code (e.g. accented letters, Cyrillic, CJK).
bimeMetadataPage.deleteConfirm: Delete metadata definition "{{name}}"? Fails if it's still assigned to any product.

bimeUnitsPage.title: Units
bimeUnitsPage.subtitle: The org's catalog of units of measure. Variants can only be set up in units that exist here.
bimeUnitsPage.createHint: Standard metric units (kg, g, m, cm, l, ml) and "units" are added automatically the first time they're used - add a custom unit here for anything else (e.g. "case", "dozen", "roll").
bimeUnitsPage.name: Name
bimeUnitsPage.deleteConfirm: Delete unit "{{name}}"? Fails if any variant still uses it.

bimeProductsPage.title: Products
bimeProductsPage.subtitle: Catalog products and their variants.
bimeProductsPage.name: Name
bimeProductsPage.tracksBatchesHint: Stock is broken down by production batch, consumed oldest-expiry-first, and covered by near-expiry alerts and recalls. Best set before any stock is recorded.
bimeProductsPage.assignMetadataHint: Replaces the full set of metadata assignments for the product.
bimeProductsPage.selectProductHint: Select a product above to view and manage its variants.
bimeProductsPage.crossProductSearchHint: Showing variants matching the selected option(s) across every product.
bimeProductsPage.skuAutoGeneratedHint: The SKU is generated automatically from the product's SKU and the selected options.
bimeProductsPage.uomConversionsHint: Sell this variant in other units too — e.g. a case of 24. Leave a price blank to use factor times the base price. New unit names are added on the Units page.
bimeProductsPage.repriceSelectedHint: Sets the same price for all selected variants, in the organization's product pricing currency (see Organizations → Billing & tax to check or change it).
bimeProductsPage.setCostSelectedHint: Sets the same cost for all selected variants, in the organization's product pricing currency (see Organizations → Billing & tax to check or change it).
bimeProductsPage.barcodeSettingsHint: Set your GS1 company prefix to issue externally valid barcodes. Leave it empty to issue in-store-only codes from the restricted-distribution range.
bimeProductsPage.barcodesHint: Link a manufacturer barcode, or issue an internal one. The primary barcode is used when this variant is shown at a register.
bimeProductsPage.printLabelsHint: Generates a printable PDF grid of barcode labels. There is no printer setup here — print the file from your computer.

bimeStockPage.title: Stock
bimeStockPage.subtitle: Record and review inventory movements and balances.
bimeStockPage.recordHint: Movements are immutable — corrections must be recorded as an adjustment.
bimeStockPage.batchGs1Hint: The data barcode on the supplier's case or carton, not the retail barcode on the unit. One scan fills in the batch code and expiry.
bimeStockPage.batchGs1CaseSub: Product, expiry and lot in one code.
bimeStockPage.batchGs1ExplainBody: Mostly on food, pharmacy and other dated goods. No GS1-128 on the box? Just type the batch and expiry.
bimeStockPage.thresholdsHint: Alerts fire the moment on-hand quantity at a location drops to or below its threshold. The location's stock alert email (set on the Locations page) receives the notification.
bimeStockPage.thresholdHint: An email is sent once per dip below this value — not on every check while it stays low.
bimeStockPage.thresholdDeleteConfirm: Remove the alert threshold for {{variant}} at {{location}}?
bimeStockPage.alertsHint: Variants currently at or below their alert threshold. A row disappears once stock recovers.

transfers.hint: Move stock between two locations as one tracked order. Nothing moves until the order is submitted, approved and dispatched.
transfers.sameLocation: Source and destination must be different.
transfers.lotsFefoHint: Lots are received earliest-expiry first. A short receipt fills them in that order.
transfers.receiveHint: Enter the quantity that actually arrived for each item. A quantity below what was dispatched leaves the rest in transit.
transfers.closeShort: Write off whatever is still in transit and complete the transfer

bimeSalesPage.title: Point of sale
bimeSalesPage.subtitle: Ring up sales by scanning items. Stock is depleted immediately.
bimeSalesPage.hint: Scan items to ring up a sale. Stock is depleted immediately; batch-tracked items are consumed earliest-expiry-first.
bimeSalesPage.locationRequired: Pick a register location to start.
bimeSalesPage.scanPlaceholder: Scan or type a barcode, then Enter
bimeSalesPage.scanHint: No scanner? Add an item by product below.
bimeSalesPage.recalledWarning: {{name}} is from a recalled batch and was not added.
bimeSalesPage.expiredWarning: Heads up: {{name}} is from an expired batch.
bimeSalesPage.noPrice: No price on file for this item. Enter a unit price.
bimeSalesPage.recentEmpty: No sales at this location yet.

bimeBatchesTab.hint: Production batches of batch-tracked products. Outbound movements consume the earliest expiry first; a recalled batch is skipped and blocked from sale.
bimeBatchesTab.recallHint: The batch will be skipped by first-expired-first-out allocation and rejected for outbound sales. A disposal adjustment is still allowed.
bimeBatchesTab.noStockLeft: No stock of this batch remains.
bimeBatchesTab.settingsHint: How many days before a batch's expiry the daily sweep starts emailing the location.

pricingPage.title: Pricing
pricingPage.subtitle: Global base price, per-module pricing, and currency exchange rates.
pricingPage.effectiveFromHint: Leave blank to take effect immediately.
pricingPage.includedInBaseHint: Bundled modules don't add to the invoice total; unbundle later without losing price history.

verifyPage.title: Set a new password
verifyPage.invalidLink: This link is missing information and can't be used. Request a new one from the login screen.

billingEmailVerifyPage.title: Confirm billing email
billingEmailVerifyPage.invalidLink: This link is missing information and can't be used. Request a new one from the organization's billing settings.

contactEmailVerifyPage.title: Confirm contact email
contactEmailVerifyPage.invalidLink: This link is missing information and can't be used. Request a new one from the organization's settings.

locationEmailVerifyPage.title: Confirm notification email
locationEmailVerifyPage.invalidLink: This link is missing information and can't be used. Request a new one from the location's settings.

VASSAGO_ADMIN.description: Can create, view, edit, and offboard any user in the organization.

VASSAGO_MEMBER.description: Can view every user in the organization, and edit their own profile.

RAUM_ADMIN.description: Operates the platform itself: manages every organization, registered services, database credentials, and pricing configuration.

RAUM_OWNER.description: Can request and download an export of this organization's own data, for backup or offboarding.

RAUM_ONBOARDING.description: Can initiate onboarding of new organizations.

BIME_ADMIN.description: Full control over products, stock, and locations, including approving transfers.

BIME_STOCK_OPERATOR.description: Manages stock movements and transfers day to day. Transfers this user raises need a separate approval before dispatch.

BIME_TRANSFER_APPROVER.description: Approves or rejects stock transfer orders. Cannot make other stock changes.

BIME_CASHIER.description: Rings up point-of-sale sales and views the catalog and stock. Cannot make other stock changes.

BIME_VIEWER.description: Can view products, stock, and locations without making changes.

BIME_CATALOG_VIEWER.description: Can only browse the product catalog, without visibility into stock levels or locations.

demo.title: Try it out
demo.hint: This is a static demo of Bime, Kenoma's inventory module — nothing here talks to a real server. Pick a shop below to explore its catalog, stock, and locations. Data is stored only in this browser and resets on request.
demo.resetConfirm: This clears every change you've made and restores the original demo data. Continue?
